patterns.note: Alternating full-width sections with high-contrast light and dark backgrounds, often centering large typographic elements or imagery.
Prominent use of a very large, elegant serif font for key headings and display text, creating a sophisticated and editorial feel.
A high-contrast palette of near-black and off-white is softened and punctuated by the muted, painterly tones of landscape imagery.
Major content blocks and large typographic elements reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they scroll into the viewport.
Distinct hero-style sections feature large, painterly landscape images as backgrounds, with minimal overlay text to set an evocative tone.

technique_notes: The site employs scroll-triggered CSS keyframe animations to reveal content sections, typically involving a subtle fade-in or slide-up as elements enter the viewport.
Large, evocative landscape paintings are utilized as fixed or subtly parallaxing background elements, creating a sense of depth as foreground content scrolls over them.
The primary navigation bar transitions from a transparent state over the initial hero section to a sticky position with a solid background color upon scrolling, ensuring persistent visibility.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, elegant serif display headings (~3-5x body text) are paired with smaller, clean sans-serif body text and uppercase labels, creating a strong visual hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on interactive elements like buttons and input fields, with a slightly more pronounced rounding on the overall page container.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy, characterized by generous vertical whitespace between major content blocks and around large display headings, contributing to an open and luxurious feel.

standout: The distinctive use of painterly, landscape-style imagery as hero and section backgrounds, combined with elegant, oversized serif typography, elevates the site beyond a typical marketing template. It feels more like an art gallery or editorial piece than a standard product page.
